ATS: home when disagreement>0, away when disagreement<0; signed residual=(actual_margin-market_margin)*sign(disagreement). Positive=win, zero=push. ATS rate excludes pushes/no_side; game count includes all.
ATS_interval: Pointwise 95% percentile bootstrap, resampling whole season-week clusters within each season, 5000 replicates, seed 20260908; not simultaneous nor evidence of independent wagers.
blend_if_stable: If eligible, weights {0,.05,.10,.15,.20,.25,.30,.40,.50,.75,1}; choose prior-season rolling validation margin CRPS only, ties favor smaller w; first evaluated year uses w=0 until an earlier validation season exists. Residual shape frozen before evaluation year, no current-year labels. Total stays the same empirical market total distribution; this is a margin-only blend, not the previous league-mean totals companion.
buckets: [0,1), [1,2), [2,3), [3,4], (4,infinity); exact zero disagreements have no model side and are reported as no_side
population: All 2639 ANY/A games; nfelo subset exactly the 946 rows with nonmissing nfelo CRPS in saved replay. No reselecting on results.
positive_stable: All 10 prior-season-fitted c point estimates strictly positive AND at least 8 of 10 pointwise 95% lower bounds strictly positive. This operational definition is fixed before this study, not a change to the promotion gate. Overlapping training windows are not independent replications.
promotion: Existing gate: lower paired margin CRPS and total CRPS no worse; preserve reconstructed/cutoff evidence restrictions. No live change from retrospective starter identities.
regression: OLS actual_margin=a+b*market_margin+c*ANYA_margin; fit on 2015 through previous season, predict evaluation season 2016-2025. Solve equivalent market plus disagreement design; map coefficients back. Week-cluster robust CR1 covariance, t interval with cluster_count-1 degrees of freedom.
spread_convention: home winning-margin points for both forecasts, not sportsbook handicap; disagreement=forecast_margin-market_margin
